actual: Two parallel QE TCN loops start one resource sampler per loop. Each sampler polls process-tree PSS plus two nvidia-smi commands every second. The R10 task logged thousands of QE_RESOURCE_GPU_SAMPLE_FAILED timeouts, while WSL dmesg showed dxgvmb_send_sync_msg and dxgkio_query_adapter_info failures exactly during training; Windows desktop froze because the display-active RTX 5080 shares WDDM scheduling. Historical identical TCN model and loader settings did not include this sampler. Fix must preserve two-loop TCN training, accurate telemetry, QE-only isolation, fail-loud evidence, and training/backtest phase semantics; no silent telemetry disable, model simplification, or training-parameter change.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
